text:
Does anyone know a notary in Israel who can translate German and Turkish documents into Hebrew for submission with a B1 visa application?

We may also need to prepare a notarized power of attorney authorizing my partner to act on my behalf and handle the visa application process, including submitting documents and communicating with the relevant authorities. Does anyone know whether such a power of attorney is actually required for the B1 process, especially if one partner is currently abroad?

If it is required, we would appreciate recommendations for a notary who can both provide certified translations and prepare/notarize the power of attorney.

Any recommendations or personal experiences would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!
